// AUTO-GENERATED by puerto. Edit puerto.toml, then run `puerto generate bootstrap`.
use std::sync::Arc;

use business::application::customer::create_customer::CreateCustomerUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::delete_customer::DeleteCustomerUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::get_customer::GetCustomerUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::list_customers::ListCustomersUseCaseImpl;
use business::application::customer::update_customer::UpdateCustomerUseCaseImpl;

use business::domain::customer::repository::CustomerRepositoryTrait;
use infrastructure::customer::repository::InMemoryCustomerRepository;

use poem::Endpoint;
use poem_openapi::OpenApiService;

use crate::api::customer::routes::CustomerApi;

/// The routes, wired. An error is what stopped the startup: `main` prints it and exits 1.
pub async fn build_app(config: puerto_web::Config) -> Result<impl Endpoint, String> {
    let customer_repo: Arc<dyn CustomerRepositoryTrait> =
        Arc::new(InMemoryCustomerRepository::new());
    let create_customer = Arc::new(CreateCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let get_customer = Arc::new(GetCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let list_customers = Arc::new(ListCustomersUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let update_customer = Arc::new(UpdateCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: Arc::clone(&customer_repo),
    });
    let delete_customer = Arc::new(DeleteCustomerUseCaseImpl {
        repository: customer_repo,
    });
    let customer_api = CustomerApi {
        create_customer,
        get_customer,
        list_customers,
        update_customer,
        delete_customer,
    };

    let ready = puerto_web::health::always_ready();

    // `app.rs` is the project's own: middleware and routes added there wrap everything here.
    Ok(crate::app::configure(puerto_web::routes(
        openapi_service(customer_api),
        &config,
        ready,
    )))
}

/// The API service, built in one place: whatever else reads its spec (the export test of a project
/// with `web/`) sees the API the server answers.
fn openapi_service<T: poem_openapi::OpenApi>(api: T) -> OpenApiService<T, ()> {
    OpenApiService::new(api, env!("CARGO_PKG_NAME"), env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"))
}
